subject: The district volume 92412838 on the north side of Södra Långgatan (numbers 39-43): the white two-storey range of 1888 and 1940 with the rusticated portal and two gables.
author: Claude (Anthropic), 2026-09-27
fixed_during_the_pass: the camera chain: the south-side bundle positions put the north facade 1.5 m too far away (window widths grew towards the edges of the 90° views); re-solved as a chain on shared window edges, anchored at both ends of the building
the gables: first read on the facade plane (the central crown at 13.15 m), then triangulated from two panoramas each (crown 11.78 m; the lunette gable 0.3 m in front of the wall, on the cornice)
the cornice: 0.61 m deep with its top at 8.88 hid the lunette; now 0.45 m, top 8.75, the corona stopping under the lunette gable
